sections.heading: Bottom-up estimates
sections.markdown:
**Regime (corrected path).** Fed HELD 3.50-3.75%, eff 3.63% (2026-07-28/29 FOMC; federalreserve.gov via the market-parameter file CORRECTION 2026-08-22 — the 4.25-4.50 citation was wrong at stamp). Next FOMC 09-15/16, Sep-hike odds ~33% un-refreshed (the macro regime memo). Underwrite hold into 2027 with possible 2027 cuts — NOT higher-for-longer at 4.25-4.50.

**Base.** FY25: NI $57,048M, diluted EPS $20.02, NII $95,443M (yfinance FY25 income stmt). H1-26 (JPM 10-Q 2026-06-30): NII $50,877M +9% y/y; avg earning assets $4.3T +$442B; net yield ex-Markets 3.65%, DOWN only 6bp y/y — NII durable through cuts already delivered.

**Build (FY26E/FY27E, $B):** NII 102/102 (hold; ~100 if 2027 cuts). Noninterest ex-gains 97/95 (IB fees +30% y/y, #1 global wallet 9.3% YTD; AUM $5.1T +18%; Markets +35% normalizes — 10-Q). Expense 107/110 (H1-26 +14% y/y, 10-Q: tech, Apple Card, revenue comp). Provision 10.5/11.5 (H1-26 $5.0B ≈ NCO $4.7B; card NCO 3.34%; allowance 1.79% loans; NPA falling — 10-Q). Tax ~21.6%. **FY26E NI ~$64B, EPS ~$23.5-24; FY27E NI ~$61B, EPS ~$23.5. Through-cycle EPS ~$23.5.** Sustainable ROE ~17%, ROTCE ~20-21% (realized 18-23% last five quarters ex 2Q26 gains — 10-Q). Load-bearing: NII durability (10-Q yield line), fee-breadth offset, provision ~through-cycle.

**Earnings-quality gate.** Provision $5.0B ≈ NCO $4.7B H1-26 — no reserve deficit, no manipulation-class flag. Optics-class (excluded from underwrite): 2Q26 $4.6B Visa exchange gain + $1.0B equity gains (10-Q fn e); Apple Card forward portfolio purchase, closing ~24m after 12/30/25 (10-Q Note 13). Related-party/structure: none. Buyback-heavy: H1 div $8.7B + buybacks $17.1B (10-Q).

sections.heading: Priors disclosure
sections.markdown: Market narrative: JPM is the quality mega-bank the crowd already owns — the Q2-2026 blowout is cycle-peak, its ~3.2x tangible-book premium is a crowded-quality bubble, and 2027 Fed cuts will compress NIM.

sections.heading: Variant perception
sections.markdown:
**Market believes:** NIM falls as cuts land, credit (card 3.34% NCO) is turning, and the 3.2x TBV premium is a peak-earnings trap — so JPM is a fade/short or, at best, fair-value with no upside.

**Why wrong:** The market mis-models NII as rate-elastic when the franchise has already repriced: H1-26 NII +9% with net yield ex-Markets down only 6bp through the delivered cuts (10-Q). Strip the one-offs and 1Q-2Q26 ROTCE is still ~23-24% vs 20-21% a year earlier — the premium is warranted, not euphoric. Residual income at COE 9.3% (UST10 4.77%, FRED 09-03 + USD ERP 4.5%), ROTCE ~20.5%, g 3.5% => warranted ~2.9-3.3x TBV; current ~3.16x is fair, so return is TBV compounding (~6%/yr) + 1.7% dividend + ~2.5%/yr buyback accretion, not de-rating.

**What proves us wrong:** ROTCE 4% without reserve build; UST10 >5.3% pushing COE above 9.8% and warranted below ~2.7x.

sections.heading: Phase-2 valuation & EV
sections.markdown: Entry $358.64 (2026-09-04 close). Trailing P/E 17.9x (FY25 $20.02); FY26E ~15x; P/BV 2.70x; P/TBV 3.16x; div yield 1.67%. COE 9.3%; warranted P/TBV ~2.9-3.3x — no re-rating gap, premium supportable by ROTCE ~21% and CET1 14.2% (10-Q). Cross-check vs S&P bank-median through-cycle ~2x TBV: JPM's premium is a deliberate quality allocation, consistent with dividend_income_anchor framing. EV: kill $304.84 < entry $358.64 < target $448.30; up 25% (3.15x TBV on H2-28 TBV ~$142) at p 0.60, down 15% (premium rejection to ~2.55x) at p 0.40; expected 12.0%/2.5y ≈ 4.8%/yr vs cash 3.63% — clears. net_div_yield 1.4% = 1.67% gross less ~15% effective US WHT (GLOBAL-sleeve treaty treatment assumed, not verified); fee_tax_drag 0.5 = fund fees. **Edge taxonomy: (a) analytical** — market mis-models NII durability and treats a warranted premium as a bubble; **(c) time-arbitrage** — 2.5y compounding under-appreciated. Not claimed: washout/structural.

sections.heading: Disconfirming facts
sections.markdown:
1. Card NCO rate already 3.34%, provision "predominantly driven by Card Services, primarily due to loan growth" (10-Q Q2-26) — a consumer normalization is underway; NCOs >4.0% with revolver growth breaks the credit underwrite.
2. UST10 already 4.77% (FRED DGS10 2026-09-03); a climb above ~5.3% lifts COE to ~9.8% and cuts warranted TBV to ~2.7x — the multiple-compression down path is live, not hypothetical.
3. Equity Markets revenue +86% y/y and Markets NII elevated (10-Q CIB) — the H1-26 fee boom is cyclical; mean-reversion to FY25 levels cuts pre-provision profit ~$4-6B/yr and proves "boom" is not the base.
4. Expenses +14% y/y H1-26, overhead 51% (10-Q) — if revenue normalizes before expense discipline returns, operating leverage reverses into 2027.

sections.heading: Pre-mortem
sections.markdown: Mid-2029 and down ~25%: a 2027 US credit turn (card NCOs past 4.5%) plus UST10 above 5.3% compressed JPM to ~2.4x TBV while fee revenue mean-reverted faster than expenses — the quality premium I called warranted proved cyclical, buybacks bought at the top, and the 1.7% dividend did not cushion a 3.2x-TBV entry. Drew found the weak joint: I priced a premium as structural that the market always knew was peak-cycle.

sections.heading: Revision
sections.markdown:
(Sloane answers Drew 1-7, 2026-09-05)

1. **Concede target.** 448.30 needs TBVPS ~142 (~+10%/yr); retention ~12.5% at ~85% payout caps book growth ~2.5%/yr and buybacks at 3.16x TBV are per-share-book dilutive, not accretive. Honest share-shrink ~3.5%/yr nets TBVPS ~130 by H2-28; 3.16x ≈ $410 (+~14%), not +25%. Target cut to 410.
2. **Concede EV.** 0.45×14 + 0.55×(−20) + 1.4×3 − 0.5 = **−1.0%/3y** vs cash 3.63% and the ~4%/yr equity bar — sub-hurdle, negative.
3. **Concede archetype.** DIA 0.60 was mechanics-fit (85% payout), not economics: a 1.67% yield is <15% of modeled return and cushions nothing. Re-keyed to quality_bank_rerating (0.48); p_up marked 0.45 below base — entry ≈ warranted 2.9-3.3x, so the win is compounding alone, no rerating gap.
4. **Concede flat-NII weak joint.** H1-26 +9% NII consumed +$442B asset growth; a 09-15/16 hawkish tail reprices the multiple and my own 2027-cut path bends NII down. Flat NII was load-bearing; I cut the target rather than defend 448.
5. **Concede.** Provision ≈ NCO with no reserve build, card NCO 3.34% rising — "through-cycle $23.5" is the FY26 peak relabeled flat into FY27. I underwrite nothing above $23.5.
6. **Partly concede.** 1.67% yield at 3.16x TBV draws no income bid and the unwind has no fundamental floor; down_pct widened to −20 with kill $287 (~2.5x current TBV). The kill is exit discipline, not a floor.
7. **Concede.** P ≈ warranted ⇒ E[r] ≈ COE 9.3%, not 4.8%/yr. A fair-value entry earns fair-value returns.

**Bottom line: negative EV, sub-hurdle at honest odds. Not fundable at any size — recommend zero/near-zero; KILL is the honest call.**
